let Engineers =
BaseData
| extend LabelsSafe = iff(isnull(Labels), dynamic([]), Labels)
| mv-expand LabelsSafe
| extend
    Name = tostring(LabelsSafe.labelName),
    Type = tostring(LabelsSafe.labelType)
| where Type == "User"
| summarize Engineer = make_set(Name) by IncidentNumber;

BaseData
| join kind=leftouter Engineers on IncidentNumber
| extend WorkingEngineer =
    iff(
        isnull(Engineer) or array_length(Engineer) == 0,
        "Unassigned",
        strcat_array(Engineer, ", ")
    )
| summarize Total = count() by WorkingEngineer
| order by Total desc

BaseData
| extend OwnerName = coalesce(
    tostring(Owner.assignedTo),
    tostring(Owner.userPrincipalName),
    tostring(Owner.email),
    "Unassigned"
)

| extend SOC_Status = case(
    Status == "New","Active",
    Status == "Active","In Progress",
    Status == "Closed","Resolved",
    Status
)

| extend SeverityScore = case(
    Severity == "High", 4,
    Severity == "Medium", 3,
    Severity == "Low", 2,
    Severity == "Informational", 1,
    0
)

| extend LabelsSafe = iff(isnull(Labels), dynamic([]), Labels)

| mv-apply L = LabelsSafe on (
    summarize WorkingEngineer = strcat_array(
        make_set_if(tostring(L.labelName), tostring(L.labelType) == "User"),
        ", "
    )
)

| extend WorkingEngineer = iff(isempty(WorkingEngineer),"Unassigned",WorkingEngineer)

| project
    Severity,
    SeverityScore,
    IncidentNumber,
    Title,
    Alerts = iff(isnull(AlertIds),0,array_length(AlertIds)),
    Provider = ProviderName,
    Created = CreatedTime,
    Updated = LastModifiedTime,
    Owner = OwnerName,
    WorkingEngineer,
    Status = SOC_Status,
    ClosingComment = ClassificationComment

| order by Updated desc
